projects.title: Featured Projects

coffeeRecipePlanner.title: Coffee Recipe Planner
coffeeRecipePlanner.shortDescription: An interactive planner for creating filter coffee and espresso-based drink recipes.
coffeeRecipePlanner.fullDescription: An interactive web application for designing personalized coffee recipes. Users can configure the brewing method, coffee dose, ratio, temperature, and desired flavor profile. The application calculates quantities, brewing times, and step-by-step instructions, and includes a preparation timer, espresso recipes, and persistent storage for saved recipes.

highlights.highlight1: Dynamic recipes for V60, Chemex, AeroPress, and French press.
highlights.highlight2: Interactive brewing timer with guided step-by-step instructions.
highlights.highlight3: Espresso planner with multiple extraction styles and milk-based drinks.
highlights.highlight4: Persistent collection for saving, loading, and deleting recipes.
highlights.highlight5: Responsive design with light and dark themes, optimized for mobile devices.

bookMemory.title: BookMemory
bookMemory.shortDescription: Web application to manage your personal library, log reading sessions, and track your daily progress.
bookMemory.fullDescription: BookMemory is a Vue 3 SPA designed to organize a personal library and turn reading into a measurable process. It lets users search and save books, log timed sessions, calculate pages read and remaining, maintain daily streaks, and review reading metrics. It also includes Firebase authentication, cloud sync, offline support, conflict resolution, a mobile-first interface, and internationalization in Spanish and English.

highlights.highlight1: Firebase authentication and route guards to protect user-specific private sections.
highlights.highlight2: Personal library with book search, manual entries, favorites, and detailed progress view.
highlights.highlight3: Reading timer to log sessions, pages read, and completion of each book.
highlights.highlight4: Dashboard with statistics, streaks, goals, daily activity, and CSV export.
highlights.highlight5: Offline mode with sync queue, conflict center, and PWA support.

streakCalendar.title: Streak Calendar
streakCalendar.shortDescription: PWA to track daily habits, maintain streaks, and visualize progress with a monthly calendar.
streakCalendar.fullDescription: Streak Calendar is a progressive web app to track daily habits, create multiple streaks, and stay consistent with a clear monthly view. It allows users to mark and unmark days, edit past records with notes, recover missed days, check current streak and best streak stats, and unlock achievements at progress milestones. It also includes JSON backup export/import, selectable visual themes, and offline functionality through a service worker.

highlights.highlight1: Daily habit tracking with quick marking for the current day.
highlights.highlight2: Support for multiple streaks with switching between active streaks.
highlights.highlight3: Monthly calendar to edit past days and add notes.
highlights.highlight4: Achievement system, accumulated progress, and missed-day recovery.
highlights.highlight5: JSON backup export/import and offline PWA operation.

redGlobal.fullDescription: Platform built for an advertising company that consolidates catalogs from five providers through APIs. It allows users to explore products, generate quotes, and manage the website from an admin panel (banners, categories, catalogs, and collections). Includes Cloudinary uploads, EmailJS notifications, and XLSX exports.
redGlobal.shortDescription: B2B marketplace for promotional products with five provider APIs, quotation module, and full admin panel.
redGlobal.title: Red Global Promocional

highlights.highlight1: Integration of 5 providers via API with data normalization
highlights.highlight2: Search, filters, and views by category/catalog
highlights.highlight4: Admin panel: images, categories, catalogs, and content management
highlights.highlight5: Media CDN with Cloudinary and forms powered by EmailJS

finControl.fullDescription: FinControl is a modern and minimalist tool to manage your personal finances, designed to help you control income, expenses, debts, and accounts all in one place. It includes transfers, savings goals, recurring payments, budgeting, and advanced settings for currency, language, themes, and security with screen-lock token.
finControl.shortDescription: Modern and minimalist application for managing personal finances.
finControl.title: FinControl

highlights.highlight2: Management of accounts, transfers, and debts
highlights.highlight5: Screen lock token and multilingual support (EN/ES)

mega.fullDescription: Megapromocionales is a modern platform for selling promotional products, developed for a corporate client. It integrates three APIs from different providers to centralize catalogs and availability, featuring a quotation system, product management, and content customization. Includes support for dynamic images, Firebase authentication, and components from the TodoVue library.
mega.shortDescription: B2B platform for promotional products with multiple API integrations and a complete management panel.
mega.title: Megapromocionales LTDA

highlights.highlight1: Integration of 3 provider APIs with data normalization
highlights.highlight2: Dynamic catalog with advanced search and filters
highlights.highlight4: Modern interface using PrimeVue and Tailwind CSS
highlights.highlight5: Content management and customizable images for clients

todoVue.fullDescription: TodoVue is a (WIP) project that combines a technical blog about Vue.js with a library of custom components. Its goal is to offer articles, demos, and reusable components with a unique style and architecture based on Atomic Design. Includes components like TvButton, TvLabel, and TvDemo, all built from scratch with Nuxt and Vite, using Markdown and integrated code highlighting.
todoVue.shortDescription: Technical blog and Vue component library with a custom style and Atomic Design approach.
todoVue.title: TODOvue

highlights.highlight1: Custom library with reusable components (TvButton, TvLabel, TvDemo)
highlights.highlight2: Technical blog integrated with Markdown and code highlighting
highlights.highlight3: Unique design based on Atomic Design and modular CSS
highlights.highlight4: Built with Nuxt and Vite for SSR and optimal performance
highlights.highlight5: Progressive publishing on npm under the todovue namespace

publistandpados.fullDescription: Publistandpados is a web platform for managing and selling promotional items, designed to optimize the user experience and simplify product administration. Developed with Vue.js and Tailwind CSS, the application offers a dynamic catalog, a quotation system, an admin panel, and advanced features such as image uploads with Cloudinary and notifications via EmailJS.
publistandpados.shortDescription: Web platform for managing and selling promotional items with a dynamic catalog and admin panel
publistandpados.title: Publistandpados

highlights.highlight1: Dynamic catalog with filters and advanced search
highlights.highlight3: Admin panel for product and content management
